scope: Guided listening to wā 8–16, chiefly genealogy and the printed 1897 genealogical supplement, with Hawaiian monarchy reception separated from original chant.
editorial_boundary: Queen Liliʻuokalani 1897 English translation is the primary textual witness; the 1889 Hawaiian edition and 1951 Beckwith edition are separate. Original English literary overview, not performed Hawaiian chant, full translation, or asserted biological historical chronology. Hawaiian custodianship and political contexts distinguished.
